name: VBScript Stager and Obfuscated PowerShell Execution (Empire Launcher)
root_cause: User 'pgustavo' executed a malicious VBScript stager ('launcher.vbs') from the Desktop via Windows Based Script Host (wscript.exe), initiated by explorer.exe. The script loaded scripting and cryptographic engines (vbscript.dll, amsi.dll, MpOAV.dll) to unpack and execute an in-memory obfuscated PowerShell payload.
remediation_actions: Isolate host WORKSTATION5.theshire.local from the corporate network.
Terminate active wscript.exe and powershell.exe processes associated with the malicious PID tree.
Reset credentials and revoke active Kerberos/NTLM sessions for THESHIRE\pgustavo.
Block identified stager hashes (SHA256: F42201B5... / MD5: 563EDAE3...) in endpoint detection policies.
